title: Expand Eurocode 1992 1993 1994 Physics
description: Expand norm/en/1992, norm/en/1993, norm/en/1994 lib.rs with real Eurocode physics: punching shear, torsion, slenderness, crack width, deflection, fire cover tables, FEM moment extraction, steel section classification and buckling curves, composite partial shear connection, na_de national annexes, and numeric tests.
summary: Expanded EN 1992/1993/1994 norm crates with real Eurocode physics: punching shear, torsion, slenderness, crack width, deflection, fire cover tables, FEM moment extraction from BeamEb2 stations, steel section classification and buckling curves a0-d, bolt bearing, fatigue categories, composite partial shear connection with eta/beff/V_L, na_de national annexes, and 25 numeric unit tests all passing.
